children.value: The large number (most!) of configurations have extremely small (effectively zero) Boltzmann factors caused by high-energy overlaps between the particles. Only a very small proportion of the phase space corresponds to low-energy configurations where there are no overlapping particles and where the Boltzmann factor has an appreciable value. These low-energy regions coincide with the physically observed phases such as solid, liquid, etc.
